integrity: The global convex-order statement has a complete analytical proof. Independent numerical quadratures and derivative checks validate a representative parameter set but are not proofs of the universal claim. The full physical model and mean work identities were established in the cited sources and are not asserted as original.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes independent Poisson alarms active only during bounded Brownian exploration, complete regeneration at one interior site, perfectly inactive absorbing boundaries during the full linear-potential return, fixed inward drift while varying return diffusivity, and strictly positive finite parameters. It does not quantify statistical robustness or apply to nonlinear return forces.
title: Exact convex-risk ordering of finite-time stochastic returns at fixed mean work
